title: Koh Samui vs Koh Phangan: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Koh Samui for families, first-timers, and luxury resort stays. Koh Phangan for budget backpackers, the Full Moon Party, and digital nomads.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Phangan north beaches (Thong Nai Pan, Bottle Beach) are exceptional. Samui has more accessible but busier beaches.

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.summary: Samui has an airport, full hospital, and paved roads. Phangan has rough roads and basic medical facilities.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Full Moon Party draws 30,000 people. Samui has a consistent Chaweng bar strip.

categories.name: Digital Nomads
categories.summary: Phangan has established coworking hubs and a larger nomad community.

categories.name: Family Travel
categories.summary: Samui has the airport, hospitals, calm beaches, and family infrastructure.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Samui has more restaurant variety across all price points.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Samui airport offers direct flights. Phangan requires ferry connections.

faq.question: Is Koh Samui or Koh Phangan better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Koh Samui — airport, hospitals, infrastructure, and beaches without planning effort.

faq.question: Which island is cheaper?
faq.answer: Koh Phangan — roughly 30-40% cheaper per day across accommodation and food.

faq.question: How far is Koh Phangan from Koh Samui?
faq.answer: 15 km, 30-45 minutes by ferry, ฿200-300 each way.
